svg.title: Known-pair oracle probabilities agree with Monte Carlo; zero-error trials retain positive confidence upper endpoints.
svg.desc: The exact Gaussian formula applies only to equal-prior hypotheses with both means fully specified: A=1,D=0.05,a=0.23 or 0.77, eight readings, sigma=0.05. Each sensor has 10,000 seeded trials; error bars are pointwise two-sided Clopper–Pearson intervals. For zero observed errors, downward triangles mark only the positive upper interval endpoint, not an estimated probability at that height. Arrows indicate continuation toward zero; their graphical tips are not positive lower confidence bounds. These are not error guarantees for unknown-amplitude/diffusivity inversion.
